authorship: Codex reviewed source-bound off-policy contracts, distinct functions on one shared upstream snapshot.

tasks.trigger: Match a dynamic integer route, then request an unknown path.
tasks.wrong: The selected regex group is used as a one-based list index; the missing-route response also changes from404 to400.
tasks.causal: Convert regex group position to the zero-based rule slot and retain the missing-route result contract.

tasks.trigger: Build a named route with an anonymous typed value and remaining query data.
tasks.wrong: Anonymous values use the wrong index and query data is joined with ampersand rather than the initial question mark.
tasks.causal: Fill zero-based anonymous placeholders and serialize remaining query parameters with the original URL separator.
tasks.observation:
from bottle import Router
r=Router();r.add('/item/<:int>','GET','target',name='anon');value=r.build('anon',3,q='space here');print('built_route_url',value)
assert value=='/item/3?q=space+here'

tasks.trigger: Register a custom named path filter and match a value through its real converter.
tasks.wrong: The filter dictionary stores callback as key and name as value, disconnecting the requested name from its converter.
tasks.causal: Bind the provided name to its factory so the unchanged router consumes the intended conversion contract.
tasks.observation:
from bottle import Router
r=Router();r.add_filter('twice',lambda config:(r'\d+',lambda value:int(value)*2,str));r.add('/n/<x:twice>','GET','target');value=r.match({'PATH_INFO':'/n/3','REQUEST_METHOD':'GET'});print('registered_filter_consumed',value)
assert value==('target',{'x':6})

tasks.trigger: Compile and render text containing an inline template expression.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite changes named grammar roles during pattern construction and reverses the three compiled pattern channels.
tasks.causal: Preserve the template grammar construction and assign split/token/inline patterns to their original roles.
tasks.observation:
from bottle import SimpleTemplate
value=SimpleTemplate(source='Hello {{name}}!').render(name='Ada');print('compiled_template_grammar',value)
assert value=='Hello Ada!'

tasks.trigger: Render literal text before and after an inline expression across a newline.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite resumes at match start instead of match end and drops literal line endings.
tasks.causal: Consume exactly the inline-expression span while preserving surrounding text and newline boundaries.
tasks.observation:
from bottle import SimpleTemplate
value=SimpleTemplate(source='one {{x}}\nend').render(x=2);print('template_text_spans',repr(value))
assert value=='one 2\nend'

tasks.trigger: Render one raw-marked and one ordinary expression containing HTML characters.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite looks for the raw marker at the end instead of the start and strips the wrong side.
tasks.causal: Decode the leading raw marker and retain normal escaping for ordinary expressions.
tasks.observation:
from bottle import SimpleTemplate
value=SimpleTemplate(source='{{!x}}|{{x}}').render(x='<b>');print('inline_escape_marker',value)
assert value=='<b>|<b>'

tasks.trigger: Render a custom-syntax template with noescape enabled.
tasks.wrong: The prepare step stores encoding in the syntax channel and inverts the noescape condition.
tasks.causal: Preserve the supplied syntax and noescape flag when configuring the real template compiler/formatter.
tasks.observation:
from bottle import SimpleTemplate
t=SimpleTemplate(source='[[x]]',syntax='<% %> % [[ ]]',noescape=True);value=t.render(x='<b>');print('template_prepared_options',value,t.syntax)
assert value=='<b>' and t.syntax=='<% %> % [[ ]]'

tasks.trigger: Render a child template that rebases into a real temporary layout file.
tasks.wrong: The helper swaps layout name and keyword dictionary in its deferred rebase tuple.
tasks.causal: Preserve the layout identifier and context dictionary channels for the subsequent real layout renderer.
tasks.observation:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from bottle import SimpleTemplate
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
 (Path(folder)/'layout.tpl').write_text('<main>{{!base}}/{{name}}</main>')
 value=SimpleTemplate(source='% rebase("layout",name="Ada")\nchild',lookup=[folder]).render();print('layout_context_consumed',value)
 assert value=='<main>child/Ada</main>'

tasks.trigger: Decode a real chunked request body using a hexadecimal size.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite decodes sizes as decimal, consumes the wrong CRLF width and continues after the terminal chunk.
tasks.causal: Retain hexadecimal chunk framing, exact CRLF consumption and terminal-chunk completion.
tasks.observation:
import io
from bottle import BaseRequest
raw=b'A\r\n0123456789\r\n0\r\n\r\n';r=BaseRequest({'wsgi.input':io.BytesIO(raw),'HTTP_TRANSFER_ENCODING':'chunked'});value=r.body.read();print('decoded_chunked_request',value)
assert value==b'0123456789'

tasks.trigger: Read multipart parser line spans across a small physical buffer boundary.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite searches lone LF, retains incorrect CR positions and marks an unterminated tail as CRLF-terminated.
tasks.causal: Yield exact content/CRLF pairs and distinguish the final unterminated span.
tasks.observation:
import io
from bottle import _MultipartParser
raw=b'first\r\nsecond\r\nlast';p=_MultipartParser(io.BytesIO(raw),'b',buffer_size=16);value=list(p._lineiter());print('multipart_line_spans',value)
assert value==[(b'first',b'\r\n'),(b'second',b'\r\n'),(b'last',b'')]

tasks.trigger: Parse a complete multipart upload through the real part consumer.
tasks.wrong: The parser forwards not-nl rather than the actual newline bytes into part.feed; some counter renames are semantically equivalent.
tasks.causal: Pass the real content/newline channels to the unchanged part state machine and require a terminating boundary.
tasks.observation:
import io
from bottle import _MultipartParser
raw=b'--edge\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="upload"; filename="a.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf8\r\n\r\nabc\r\n--edge--\r\n'
parts=list(_MultipartParser(io.BytesIO(raw),'edge').parse())
print('multipart_parser_flow',len(parts),parts[0].file.read());parts[0].file.seek(0)
assert len(parts)==1 and parts[0].name=='upload' and parts[0].file.read()==b'abc'
parts[0].close()

tasks.trigger: Parse standard multipart Content-Disposition and Content-Type headers.
tasks.wrong: The rewrite splits on comma, rejects semicolons used by header options and crosses continuation name/value channels.
tasks.causal: Parse the real colon-delimited header grammar and preserve continuation values.
tasks.observation:
import io
from bottle import _MultipartParser
raw=b'--edge\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="upload"; filename="a.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf8\r\n\r\nabc\r\n--edge--\r\n'
parts=list(_MultipartParser(io.BytesIO(raw),'edge').parse())
print('multipart_header_grammar',parts[0].headers.get('Content-Type'))
assert parts[0].headers['Content-Disposition'].startswith('form-data;') and parts[0].headers['Content-Type']=='text/plain; charset=utf8'
parts[0].close()

tasks.trigger: Feed a valid multipart upload across header and body phases.
tasks.wrong: The dispatcher sends the header phase to write_body and the established-file phase back to write_header.
tasks.causal: Route feed events to the header or body consumer according to current file state.

from bottle import _MultipartParser
raw=b'--edge\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="upload"; filename="a.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf8\r\n\r\nabc\r\n--edge--\r\n'

tasks.trigger: Complete multipart header parsing for a named file with content type and charset.
tasks.wrong: Decoded name/filename channels and parsed Content-Type indexing are changed before fields are assigned.
tasks.causal: Assign each decoded metadata value to its original field; the HTTP-header parser itself remains unchanged.
tasks.observation:

from bottle import _MultipartParser
raw=b'--edge\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="upload"; filename="a.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf8\r\n\r\nabc\r\n--edge--\r\n'

tasks.trigger: Complete a valid multipart part and read its uploaded bytes.
tasks.wrong: The completion guard rejects existing file state and otherwise seeks past the first byte.
tasks.causal: Accept a closed-header part and rewind its stream before handing it to the next consumer.
tasks.observation:
import io
from bottle import _MultipartParser
raw=b'--edge
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="upload"; filename="a.txt"
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf8

abc
--edge--
'
parts=list(_MultipartParser(io.BytesIO(raw),'edge').parse())
p=parts[0];print('completed_part_stream',p.file.tell());assert p.file.tell()==0 and p.file.read()==b'abc';p.close()

tasks.trigger: Close an actual parsed multipart part twice.
tasks.wrong: The method replaces the file with None and immediately calls close on that inactive sentinel.
tasks.causal: Close the owned stream, mark the part inactive and make a subsequent close safe.
tasks.observation:
import io
from bottle import _MultipartParser
raw=b'--edge\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="upload"; filename="a.txt"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain; charset=utf8\r\n\r\nabc\r\n--edge--\r\n'
parts=list(_MultipartParser(io.BytesIO(raw),'edge').parse())
p=parts[0];stream=p.file;p.close();p.close();print('released_part_resource',stream.closed,p.file)
assert stream.closed and p.file is False
